concept: One Report, one laptop, on a plain light field: the backup system builds itself on screen, copy by copy (laptop, external drive, cloud), each copy proven by a failure it survives, while the 3, 2 and 1 marks light one by one; the opening failure is replayed and survived at the close.
world: A plain light field (corporate-clean, dot grid, quiet blue mesh) holding one system board: laptop at left centre, external drive beside it on a drawn desk line, cloud far right, the 3-2-1 rail of tiles under them. Stations: board (0,0) for the system; offline (0,1300) a detail below the board for the connected-versus-offline contrast; bag (2400,0) the check's own place; yours (4800,0) the closing checklist. No people.

devices.what: one persistent board on the plain light field: laptop, external drive and cloud, each a drawn kit object holding its own Report copy; held across beats with continue joins and changed in state on the spoken word

the 3, 2 and 1 marks as three physical tiles on a rail under the board: unlit (surface2), lit (accent while named, ink after), missing (dashed outline with a neg tag); lit one by one, then reused unlit as the check and as the closing checklist
a rounded dashed boundary drawn round everything in one place (the desk, later the bag); one event fills the whole boundary and takes every copy inside it
the opening failure (the laptop drive dies, the report empties to an outline) replayed exactly in the payoff, this time survived
join material, handoff, used once: the restored Report carries from the board into the closing checklist

value_script.why: pale open: one laptop, one file on the bare light field
slightly richer middle as the system fills in; b07's event fills the boundary in slate, the one darker moment
the check in its own place on a field2 band
lift at the close: the failure survived, a pos Restored tag, the checklist

sections.treatment: bespoke motion on the system board

beats.line: One Report file sits inside one laptop on the bare field; a Due tomorrow tag hangs from it.
The laptop's drive fails (screen goes dark, a neg Drive failed tag); the Report empties to an outline.

sections.treatment: bespoke, a label on the held outline and the 3-2-1 rail arrives

beats.line: The empty outline is labelled Single point of failure; the 3-2-1 rail of three unlit tiles arrives large beside it.

sections.treatment: bespoke, four failures land on the single copy

beats.line: The Report is whole again; four failure chips land on it one per word (Drive failure, Lost or stolen, Deleted by mistake, Ransomware), each emptying it.

sections.treatment: bespoke, the board grows copy by copy; one detail station below for offline

beats.line: The Report copies twice into three files in a row; one is struck out and two remain whole; tile 3 lights.
A copy travels from the laptop to an external drive; a fault strikes the laptop only, the drive's copy stays whole; tile 2 lights.
A dashed Same place boundary draws round the desk; one event fills the boundary in slate and both copies empty together.
The camera widens; a copy travels out of the boundary to a cloud far right, beyond the event's reach; tile 1 lights.
Below the board: laptop with two backup drives, one on a cable (connected), one unplugged (offline); a lock travels the cable into the connected copy, the offline copy stays clean.
Back on the board at rest: laptop, external drive and cloud each with a whole copy, tiles 3, 2 and 1 lit with their labels.

sections.treatment: bespoke check in its own place: the bag

beats.line: A bag outline holds a laptop and a USB drive, each with a Report copy; the 3-2-1 tiles sit unlit below; the question waits.
Tiles 3 and 2 light, tile 1 stays a dashed outline tagged Missing: 1 offsite; then the bag slides off the field with both copies.

sections.treatment: bespoke replay on the board, then the checklist

beats.line: The b02 failure replays exactly on the laptop; this time the Report travels back from the external drive and opens whole, a pos Restored tag; the cloud copy stays whole.
The restored Report carries into a checklist: three file objects, each beside the 3, 2 and 1 tiles, unticked, waiting for the viewer.
